files.name: rslogix5000_1756-l63_download-upload-run.pcap
devices: 1756-L63/A ControlLogix controller, firmware 15.4 ("1756-L63/A L6x_15_31"), serial 0x0014CD8A, slot 0 behind the EtherNet/IP module at 10.92.18.17 (Identity object, frame 222)
peers: RSLinx (Rockwell Software, vendor 0x004D) for RSLogix 5000, originator serials 0x11FA6145 and 0x21217FA7
operations: command 0x0001, ListServices, ListInterfaces, RegisterSession
Unconnected_Send to the controller (route port 1, link 0): Identity Get_Attributes_All and Get_Attribute_List, Message Router Get_Attributes_All, Program Name Get_Attribute_List
Forward_Open and Forward_Close (Class 3 to the Message Router)
connected Get_Attribute_List and Multiple Service Packets of Logix objects (0x68, 0x69, 0x6B, 0x70, 0x72, 0x73, 0x7E, 0x8E, 0xAC)
Get_Attribute_Single Identity status, an unknown class (0x334, general status 0x05)
files.limitations: The download, upload and run of the file name use Rockwell-private objects whose services are not documented publicly; they are decoded only to the CIP level.

files.name: factorytalk_1756-l63_hmi-reads.pcap
devices: the same 1756-L63/A as controllogix-download: same address, same originator serial 0x11FA6145 three minutes earlier, the same Identity status 0x3160 (frame 449) and the same answer of class 0xAC
peers: FactoryTalk View / RSLinx Enterprise (vendor 0x004D, originator serial 0x11FA6145)
operations: connected messaging on three Class 3 connections, the capture starting inside the first
Forward_Open (Class 3, RPI 2 s, 504 octets)
Template object (0x6C): Get_Attributes_All and Read Template of the predefined COUNTER (0x0F82) and TIMER (0x0F83) templates
Read_Modify_Write_Tag by instance (Program 0x68 / Symbol 0x6B)
Identity Get_Attribute_Single status
RSLinx-private class 0xB2
files.limitations: Starts mid-connection: the first connection's Forward_Open is not in the file.

files.name: rockwell-originator_unknown_forward-open-class1.pcap
devices: targets 192.168.100.36 and .35, not identified in the traffic
peers: an originator of vendor 1 (Rockwell Automation), originator serial 0x0013F522
operations: ListServices, RegisterSession
Forward_Open Class 1 cyclic, 10 ms, O->T point-to-point 26 octets, T->O multicast 26 octets, electronic key of zeros, Assembly 6 / connection points 2 and 1
retransmitted Forward_Open requests without reply (frame 5)

files.name: hmi_logix_bit-writes.pcap
devices: four Logix-like targets (141.81.0.23, .43, .63, .83) answering class 0xAC and symbolic Read_Modify_Write_Tag; not identified
peers: one originator, 141.81.0.10 (an HMI or SCADA server)
operations: Multiple Service Packets of symbolic Read_Modify_Write_Tag (0x4E) on bit tags
Unconnected_Send to class 0xAC
class 0x72 reads
files.limitations: The same file is in EmreEkin/ICS-Pcaps (Ethernet_IP/EthernetIP-CIP.pcap, identical SHA256); Ethernet_IP/mb.pcap and CIP/CIP.pcap there hold the same EtherNet/IP messages merged with other traffic.

files.name: unknown_mixed_list-identity-browse-io.pcap

192.168.10.120, a Logix-like target (answers class 0xAC); not identified — class C
the I/O producers 192.168.1.22 and .24; not identified — class C
